Introduction.hero_heading_text: Great success begins with choosing the right job you love.
Introduction.platforms_desc: Our platform collects job data from online recruitment platforms. The data is updated every day to provide reliable information for IT job market guidance.
Introduction.platforms_itviec_desc: ITViec is one of the leading IT recruitment platforms in Vietnam. It connects thousands of IT professionals with trusted companies.
Introduction.platforms_topdev_desc: TopDev is a leading IT recruitment platform in Vietnam. It helps developers find jobs at technology companies.
Introduction.platforms_itjobs_desc: ITJobs is a job website for IT professionals in Vietnam. It offers many career opportunities in the technology industry.
Introduction.features_subtitle: We combine IT job market data with your personal skills to provide career advice that matches company needs.
Introduction.feature_1_desc: Collect and analyse the skills required for different jobs to identify the most in-demand skills.
Introduction.feature_2_desc: Use RAG and Semantic Search to provide relevant IT job market information for career guidance.
Introduction.feature_3_desc: Analyse your goals, skills, and CV to give you better and more personal career recommendations.

Footer.description: An IT job market guidance platform that helps users find the right career path.

AIJMCInfo.problem_1_desc: Provide an IT career guidance system based on the latest recruitment trends and job market data.
AIJMCInfo.problem_2_desc: Help IT job seekers find jobs that match their skills, interests, and career goals.
AIJMCInfo.problem_3_desc: Show that a multi-agent system can support career guidance through analysis, recommendations, and personalisation.
AIJMCInfo.goals_desc: Build an AI IT Job Market Consultant based on a multi-agent architecture. The system can collect, process, and analyse recruitment data from different sources.
AIJMCInfo.foundation_1_desc: Based on research by T. M. Nguyen and other studies on AI agents and multi-agent systems.
AIJMCInfo.foundation_2_desc: Based on career guidance studies by Q. Peng and research by Q. Wang and colleagues.
AIJMCInfo.aim_1_desc: Gather and analyse system requirements through literature review and user stories to complete the Software Requirements Specification (SRS).
AIJMCInfo.aim_2_desc: Study AI agents, multi-agent systems, large language models (LLMs), RAG, and semantic search.
AIJMCInfo.aim_3_desc: Design and develop a market analysis agent, a personalisation agent, and a recommendation agent.
AIJMCInfo.aim_4_desc: Develop job search, career chatbot, and personal skill dashboard features.
AIJMCInfo.aim_5_desc: Deploy the system to a VPS, perform system testing, and complete the graduation project report.

FounderInspiration.name: Van Trung Thanh
FounderInspiration.bio_1: I am a third-year Information Technology student, majoring in Software Engineering with AI at
FounderInspiration.bio_school: Ho Chi Minh City Open University.
FounderInspiration.bio_2: I enjoy building reliable and scalable systems with Python and JavaScript. My work is guided by four values: quality, completeness, sustainability, and innovation.
FounderInspiration.quirk_desc: I sometimes overthink deadlines and can feel burned out. However, I still manage to finish my work well. In IT, I believe my biggest strength is persistence rather than problem-solving talent.
FounderInspiration.skill_1_desc: I have experience in fine-tuning AI models and using AI agents to automate software development tasks.
FounderInspiration.skill_2_desc: Security and deployment are important parts of software development. A good repository should have a clear CI/CD workflow to manage security, code quality, and commits.
FounderInspiration.skill_3_desc: There are many ways to build a system, but it is important to understand why we choose a specific design. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) help explain these decisions.
FounderInspiration.story_paragraph_1: This project was inspired by a common problem in today's IT job market. Many IT professionals work in jobs that do not match their skills or career goals.
FounderInspiration.story_paragraph_2: For example, a tester who enjoys software testing should not have to apply for a Frontend Designer job just to find work. A junior developer should not be lost among job posts that only ask for senior experience.
FounderInspiration.story_paragraph_3: The gap between personal skills and job opportunities inspired AIJMC. With the help of artificial intelligence, building an IT job market guidance platform is becoming a reality.

general_faqs.a: AIJMC (AI IT Job Market Consultant) is a multi-agent system designed to analyze the dynamic IT job market and provide highly personalized career roadmaps based on your unique skill set.

general_faqs.q: Who is the primary audience for this platform?
general_faqs.a: It is built for IT professionals at all levels—from fresh graduates looking for their first break to senior engineers navigating complex career transitions.
No. We are a market intelligence and consultation platform. We arm you with data, trends, and precise job matching, but you apply directly to the companies.

general_faqs.q: Is the platform free to use?
general_faqs.a: The core features, including basic skill mapping and job market trends, are entirely free. Premium deep-dive analytics may be introduced in the future.

technical_faqs.q: How does the AI evaluate my skills?
technical_faqs.a: Our recommendation agent utilizes advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and semantic search to compare your profile context against thousands of active job descriptions in real-time.

technical_faqs.q: Where does your job data come from?
technical_faqs.a: We ethically aggregate and synthesize real-time data from Vietnam's leading IT recruitment platforms, including ITViec, TopDev, and ITJobs.

technical_faqs.q: How often is the market data updated?
technical_faqs.a: The data pipeline processes updates daily to ensure that the trends, tech stacks, and job recommendations reflect the absolute latest state of the market.
Absolutely. Your skill assessments, resumes, and career preferences are processed securely and are never sold to third-party advertisers or external agencies.
